essence: For an aṇu endowed with karmic residue, the property of being a cause would hold in the sphere of embodied existence.
What is established by reasoning is not the admission of another distinct effect, but the meaning given by that exclusion.
For those attached to objects, afflictions of varied and noble forms arise as part of the embodied situation under consideration.
The account given so far is offered as sufficient for closure of this unit, with further demonstration deferred to another section.
